name: push-up-jacks
instructions:
1. Assume a quadruped position on the floor with your hands under your shoulders, toes tucked, and knees under hips.
2. Extend one leg at a time and assume a pushup position with the legs straight, elbows extended, and head in a neutral position looking at the floor.
3. Unlock the legs and hop to a slightly wider than shoulder width stance.
4. Slowly descend to the floor by retracting the shoulder blades and unlocking the elbows.
5. Descend until the upper arms are parallel or your chest touches the floor.
6. Push back to the starting point by extending the elbows and driving your palms into the floor.
7. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
